# Unique Business Canvas: one signal, refracted into a business

*Canonical template, synthesized 2026-10-27 by Evolver from four tellings of the Unique Business method, the canvas template, and the three deepening templates (Genealogy at the end). The Integrated Unique Business Playbook stays the domain parent and the long-form source of truth; this file is the working method in one place. Where tellings differ, the newer Sasha-confirmed one wins; older claims stay as dated notes.*

## 1. Essence in two sentences
"Your unique business is the one signal you carry within turned into a business. Your uniqueness articulation generates the core signal, your shadow names its inversion, myth universalizes it into a law, tribe polarizes around that law, and pain, promise, offer, marketing, comms, and distribution all inherit the same signal." (Playbook, Integrated Stack, v4.6, 2026-04-26)

## 2. Laws that hold every artifact
1. **Two forms.** Full-signal (the founder's language) + universal language (a teenager understands it; "this IS the marketing").
2. **The body scores.** Precision 1–10 is the founder's body, not their mind; "if the facilitator or AI says 9 but the founder feels 7, it's 7."
3. **Only higher replaces.** A new version replaces the previous only if its precision is higher.
4. **Highest-rated version rule** (2026-04-09): derive downstream only from the highest-scored full-signal version; never re-distil what the founder already scored; cite the source version ("derived from Uniqueness v1.0, 9.9/10").
5. **Timestamp everything** (2026-07-20): every version, score and prediction carries its date: the trail is the dataset.
6. **Three public lines, versioned** (2026-08-22): business tagline, uniqueness tagline, mission; newest on top, never delete a spoken version.
7. **Forged, not drafted:** articulate → roast → distil → repeat; minimum 3 versions before building on it.
8. **Error detection from below:** an error in artifact N shows when building N + 1. When an artifact feels off, check the one above it.
9. **The last mile:** AI gets an artifact to ~9; the founder's own rewrite from inside the tribe's skin closes it to 10.
10. **Function, not form:** the canvas describes a function; the vehicle (1:1, product, own venture, ecosystem role, connector) is chosen for the season and can change without changing the canvas.
11. **Stream 0:** run it on yourself first (mask on first).
12. **ONE of everything:** one segment, one myth, one pain, one Point B, one funnel, one channel, one ladder.

### Precision thresholds (2026-03-23)
| Body score | Unlocks | Do |
|---|---|---|
| 8.0+ | direction is right | polish, don't restart; downstream may be drafted, not finalized |
| 9.2+ | downstream in earnest | start Pain, Promise |
| 9.5+ | full strategy activation | stop polishing, act; precision now comes from market contact |
| 9.9+ | polish territory | refinement, not architecture; ship |

## 3. The artifact sequence (derivation order)
| # | Artifact | Question | Output | Gate (human in the loop) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Uniqueness** | Who am I at my brightest? | Unique Gift card (vibrational key, compound archetype, essence) + **tagline ~7 words**, roasted 3 rounds + meta-roast | "Does this feel true?" (emotional resonance, not agreement) |
| 1.5 | **Shadow** | What is the inverted trap of my gift? | anatomy: Surface → Middle → Root → Inversion; the recursive trap ("I need to [apply my gift to myself] before I can [apply it to others]"); collapse condition; one-line + paragraph; universal-language version | **two dials:** resonance (1–10) *and* **charge** (0–10, how much it stings): landed when charge is high and a minute later they can still say "это про меня" |
| 2 | **Myth** | What must be true about the world for my work to be inevitable? | Master Lie / Master Belief; the Lie, the Truth, the Line; anatomy (seed, soil, sunlight, water); layers (attack, reframe, invitation) | **collapse test:** "If someone proves [the opposite], my business collapses" → yes = myth; no = preference |
| 3 | **Tribe (ICP)** | Who recognizes themselves in this myth? | qualifiers (inner state) → segments → life situation (why now) → speakable synthesis paragraph; anti-tribe (what they want, say, do); named people | "Can you name 5 real people?"; somatic confirmation (chills, humility, tears) |
| 4 | **Pain (Point A)** | What is their situation and why is it unbearable? | 5-Layer Slicer v2.0 per segment (§4) + self-language inventory (8–12 phrases) + recursive shadow per segment | "Would they cry reading this?" and does the founder's heart open writing it? |
| 5 | **Promise (Point B)** | What is the master transformational result? | inversion table pain → promise; one sentence, full-signal + universal | "Can you say it naturally in conversation?" |
| 5.5 | Transformational Result | A → B as one deliverable sentence | the Master Result for the product | nearly automatic at pain 9.5+ |
| 5.6 | Trinity sub-results | three felt wins (mini A → mini B) | e.g. "Name your craft · See your business · Know your first move" | discovered with holonic seeing, not invented |
| 5.7 | 1st session design | guaranteed results without overwhelm | universal-language results + a silhouette of the full journey | would a stranger on the page know what they walk away with? |
| 6 | **Lead magnet** | how does the pain card reach them? | at pain 9.95 the pain card IS the lead magnet; one format, one channel | "how do they know this about me?" |
| 7 | **Value ladder** | the hero's journey as ascending containers | 0 lead magnet (recognition) → 1 entry (initiation) → 2 journey (building) → 3 container (embodiment) + the River Step (who gets the first message) | each step earns the next |

**The domino:** myth + tribe are ~80 % of the work; the rest cascades. **Pain before promise:** the insight lives in Point A; Point B is guaranteed by the uniqueness.

From 2026-02-20 the playbook, the canvas template v5–v6 and the builder code all derive **uniqueness first**, myth from uniqueness, tribe from myth ("Don't define tribe first. Forge myth, watch who magnetizes"); the offer (Excalibur) becomes downstream of pain and promise. Canonical: the table above. The early insight survives as the collapse test and the "photon of truth" (find the one unbreakable sentence first).
> *Scale, current decision (Sasha, 2026-10-27):* the canvas has **six** parts: **Uniqueness, Shadow, Myth, Tribe, Transition, Transformational Promise** («сейчас вообще получается шесть: уникальность, тень, миф, трайб, переход, земля обетованная»; renamed to Transformational Promise, Sasha 2026-10-28). The table above stays as the working derivation order underneath.
> *Dated history of the scale:* the canvas template counted **7** artifacts (FMF masterclass, 2026-10-24: "The Unique Business OS: 7 Artifacts"); the playbook added Shadow (**8**) and steps 5.5–5.7; Sasha's own canvas tracks **18** rows (Dream Outcome, Strategy, Method, Proof, Golden DM, …). Hark's earlier reading (7 public faces, 8 working artifacts, the rest a mature canvas's extensions) is superseded by the six.

## 4. Pain: the 5-Layer Slicer v2.0 (2026-02-23)
Apply in this order, per segment; each layer gives two outputs: what's seen from outside + the self-talk they are aware of (their awareness stage).
1. **Pressure** (Давление): what's pushing toward a decision now; map the compounding **loop**, not just the sources.
2. **Consequences** (Последствия): the felt texture daily: body, inner dialogue, closest relationship, the mask and for whom.
3. **Cost of inaction** (Цена бездействия): 6–12 months forward; usually not bankruptcy but **resignation**; the abyss they won't say out loud.
4. **Urgency** (Рычаги срочности): what countdown already runs; tipping points; the worst stake they can't admit.
5. **Struggle synthesized** (Борьба): the structural pattern; "the one sentence that would make them freeze and say '…yes, that's exactly it'."

"When you START with struggle, you get the surface complaint. When you ARRIVE at struggle… you get the structural truth."
**Unlocks at 9.95:** inverse pain = automatic product spec; near-zero false positives ("copy doesn't sell, it searches").
**Empathy first** (Sandra, 2026-03-23): precision without empathy = manipulation; empathy without precision = therapy; both = tuning fork.
**Confabulation layer:** the tribe can't diagnose its own root cause ("the market wasn't ready"); listen for what they don't say.
**Awareness:** Schwartz 1–5 plus the **layer-aware** rung (2026-07-27): "it is not effort, it is the layer." Message must match the rung, not the position.

> *Dated note, and a drift found in synthesis:* v1 of the slicer (2026-02-14) started with **Struggle** and ended with Urgency. The docs were aligned to v2.0 on 2026-10-28: the Creation Playbook, the `genius-business` workflow, the ICP Deepening prompt and the Pain Mapping Template table in `pain_theory_playbook.md`. The live `deepen-icp` function still runs v1 (struggles before pressure) and waits for Sasha's ok on a Lovable deploy. `deepen-pain` already runs Pressure first.

## 5. Tribe: signal first (PST 72)
- Define the tribe by what's **alive** in them (an unmistakable creative signal they can't yet name), not by what's broken.
- **Resonance sort:** AI scans sub-tribes at 3+ precision tiers → the founder reorders by body → the founder adds what AI missed → AI synthesizes → somatic confirmation.
- **Situational, not identity labels** in copy ("people who know they have something real but it's not becoming a real business", not "founders in transition"). **The tribe is a trajectory** (PST 127), read as motion, not category.
- Each segment: how they arrived, the grind, the dream (in **their** words), what they tell themselves.
- **Ripeness read** next to the tribe (PST 123): the 9-axis vector with Surrender, Means and Ticking Clock as multiplicative gates.

## 6. The deepening engine (any artifact, productized for ICP, Promise, Pain)
One chain, the same for every artifact (ICP and TP templates are identical in shape, 2026-01-24):
1. **Projection:** project the artifact through its depth questions (ICP: the slicer + awareness + self-language; Promise: Point A felt, the invisible bridge, Point B lived, the stakes, the promise crystallized).
2. **Roast 1:** critique only, harsh and specific; ❌ no fixing.
3. **Roast 2:** deeper: what the first roast missed; what someone who failed / succeeded would say; still no fixing.
4. **Meta-roast:** roast the roast: its biases, what it protects, what question isn't asked.
5. **Synthesis:** only now rebuild, addressing every valid critique.
6. **Repeat** 2–5 for **3 cycles** (15+ calls); the user sees one button and one "wow."
This is [holonic-seeing.md](./holonic-seeing.md) Rounds 1–4 in production form: Roast 2 = Round 2 (correct the under-served), Meta-roast = Round 3 (the 26th).

**Output shapes:** ICP → name and archetype; who they are; daily reality; words they use; what keeps them up; what they've tried; what would change their life; why now; what's at stake. Promise → one-line promise; Point A (metaphor title); the journey; Point B (metaphor title); stakes; "I help [ICP] go from [A feeling] to [B reality] through [method]."

## 7. The hypothesis and its validation loop
**PMF hypothesis, extended** (Venture Growth Playbook, 2025-10-01): *If A experiencing E had C, they'd have no more B and get D.* (A = one person in a concrete situation; E = their inner voice at the desperate moment; B = the highest frustration; C = the absurdly simple solution; D = the dream outcome.) Short form (2026-02-14): *If A had B, they'd have no more C.* Discovery order: person → pain → solution, never backwards.
**Validate before building:** write hypotheses down → score each on urgency, importance, problem awareness → keep every version → problem interviews until confusion clears → leanest solution → low-fi prototype → model and price → solution interviews → **sell** ("sales is the ultimate PMF signal").
**Competitor read:** reduce any company's site to its one-sentence PMF hypothesis.

## 8. From canvas to market (the expression half)
After the canvas, in this order: **Blueprint** (3-phase method, "converts X into Y", e.g. MAP → MATCH → MOVE; explainable in 30 s) → **Positioning** (pain-, method-, result-forward; myth-forward deepest) → **Landing page** (experience this? → promise → CTA → three steps → what each feels like → proof → booking; with the resonance permission line) → **Distribution** (max 3 channels: warm, one content home, referral loop) → **Launch** (revenue target ÷ price = sessions; ×2 conversations; ×2.5 outreach; ÷ 14 days). Each has its own home (marketing, distribution playbooks; future landing template); kept here as the path, not the craft.

## 9. The dashboard (top of every canvas)
Name & surfaces · tribe (9+) · top talent (9+) · **Master Tuning Forks** (primary: "I help {tribe} turn {input} into {outcome}, {quality}, in {timeframe}"; compressed; **transformation arc**: "{tribe member} walks in {challenged situation} into my digital shop, and walks out, {timeframe} later, with {result}") · value ladder snapshot · current state (cohort, revenue, next milestone) · **Artifact Status** table (version, precision, status, date) · the canvas on half a page (one line per artifact). Copy `docs/02-strategy/unique_business_canvas_template.md` as `[name]s_unique_business.md` for the full fill-in skeleton.

**Drift signals** (you've left the path): you need willpower; you're hiding part of the method; product, marketing and distribution feel separate; a reach-out fails the energy test; you feel you must do more. Recovery: return to the uniqueness and speak from it.
